Mages check every requisition against existing contracts and prior purchases, flag the cheaper contracted supplier and terms, and apply your compliance controls before the PO issues. Mages read contracts, invoices, and transaction history together, catching price deviations, missed rebates, unearned volume discounts, and weak supplier performance the moment they appear, with the evidence attached. Find cheaper alternatives Magentic spots where an equivalent product costs far less, then shows exactly how much you would save by switching to it. Buy on the best terms Magentic catches purchases heading off-contract or above the agreed price, and points to the approved supplier and better terms before the order goes out. Recover leaked value Magentic scans years of orders and invoices to surface overpayments, missed rebates, and off-contract charges, shows exactly how much you can claim back, and then implements the best way to recover the leakage. Reads every contract Magentic reads your supplier agreements and pulls out the terms that matter, from pricing and obligations to liability caps, so nothing stays buried in a PDF. Built on your data Magentic connects your contracts, ERP, invoices, emails, and spreadsheets into one procurement data model, matching the same supplier or part across every system, language and format. Helping a global beverage manufacturer deploy an AI workforce to protect margins - Magentic Capabilities Industries Security Customers Stories About us Learn more CUSTOMERS Helping a global beverage manufacturer deploy an AI workforce to protect margins Industry Consumer packaged goods Cases Price variance / price arbitrage detection, Supplier and SKU consolidation, Maverick (off-contract) spend Technology stack SAP ECC, SAP Ariba, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Consumer packaged goods companies are being squeezed from both sides. Raw material, energy, and logistics costs keep rising, while consumers are becoming more price-sensitive, making it harder to pass those increases on. For procurement teams, that means finding new ways to hunt down value, while balancing risk. When a global beverage manufacturer approached Magentic, this task was still highly manual and time-consuming. Category managers had to work hard to field opportunities across previously neglected indirect spend categories, navigating fragmented systems, with no scalable way to turn data into evidence-backed cases without heavy manual analysis. With teams already stretched, they didn’t need another dashboard, but a way to automate the work while remaining in full control. Magentic's AI digital workers stepped in to handle the work end to end. Extending roll-out across spend categories By working with Magentic, the team can move fast to capture value while reducing costs and operational risk. After starting with office equipment, administration, and IT hardware and peripherals, the company is now working with Magentic on supporting more complex areas of the business. "Previously, we only had the capacity to pay attention to the big spend. Magentic gives us total oversight of every type of purchase such as laptops, which always been difficult to capture. The Mages assistance for indirect spend has been invaluable.” IT Procurement leader "Previously, we only had the capacity to pay attention to the big spend. Magentic gives us total oversight of every type of purchase such as laptops, which always been difficult to capture. The Mages assistance for indirect spend has been invaluable.” IT Procurement leader "Previously, we only had the capacity to pay attention to the big spend. Magentic gives us total oversight of every type of purchase such as laptops, which always been difficult to capture. The Mages assistance for indirect spend has been invaluable.” IT Procurement leader Accelerating time to value Together, we launched a two-month pilot to see how Magentic’s digital workers, Mages, could help the team stay on top of spend. The Mages work like the teams already do; analysing data directly from systems, such as SAP and Ariba, while cleaning up data as they go - no prior integration needed. Spend variances are checked automatically, while maverick spend is prevented without each invoice being checked by hand. Category managers are only looped in for validation through a lightweight review process - with the evidence for each case attached. Each case comes with a set of recommended actions, replacing a previously slow and manual audit and execution process. editorial_method: Primary-source review; no account or live workflow tested.

zh.summary: 在制造采购中寻找、保护和追回应有的供应链价值。
zh.judgment: 价值应落到经财务确认的节省，而不是模型发现的一大串机会。
zh.replaces: 采购团队跨系统比材料、合同和付款，人工找合并采购与追偿机会。
zh.product: 官网将能力分成购买前价值发现、购买中合规保护和购买后追偿，围绕材料身份、合同与支付流程。它接近采购工作执行，不是仅回答供应链问题。
zh.customer: 制造企业采购、供应链与财务团队是目标。买方可能为可确认的成本与回款改善付费，但需要区分建议节省、谈妥节省与实际到账。
zh.workflow: 公司描述匹配不同系统里的等价材料、聚合需求，并检查采购请求与既有合同、追踪供应商义务。审批、供应商关系和付款控制需保留明确责任。
zh.business_model: 本次未取得公开价目。机构合同或与可验证价值关联的收费是研究假设；数据清理、材料匹配与采购专家复核可能形成较高前置成本。
zh.traction: 官网有 Siemens 采购负责人评价与客户资料，属于公司和客户发布。没有取得独立节省审计、续费或每项目完整交付成本。
zh.moat: 材料等价关系、合同知识和采购历史可能形成壁垒。ERP、支出分析、咨询和内部采购专家是替代，结果需要真正能进入采购决策。
zh.funding_read: 融资可支持企业部署，不说明发现的价值都已兑现。下一里程碑是同客户持续采用以及财务确认的净节省。
zh.risks: 误认等价材料可能影响质量，过时合同可能产生错误供应商建议。节省归因、执行依赖和实施成本还可能让项目回报被高估。
zh.takeaway: 把发现机会与实际执行、财务确认连起来。为每项节省保留基线、责任人和兑现状态，而不是只展示总机会金额。
zh.watch_next: 看机会兑现率、净节省、材料误匹配和实施时间。跟踪同客户第二个采购类别是否能更低成本复用。

en.summary: Procurement agents finding, protecting and recovering supply-chain value for manufacturers.
en.judgment: Finance-confirmed savings matter more than a long list of suggested opportunities.
en.replaces: Comparing materials, contracts and payments across systems to identify consolidation and recovery manually.
en.product: The site separates pre-purchase discovery, purchasing controls and post-purchase recovery around item identity, contracts and payments. This is execution-oriented procurement work.
en.customer: Procurement, supply-chain and finance teams are audiences. Proposed, negotiated and realized savings are different evidence; buyers need confirmed outcomes.
en.workflow: The described flow matches equivalent items, aggregates demand, checks requests against contracts and enforces obligations. Approval, supplier relationships and payment responsibility remain important.
en.business_model: No public prices were retrieved. Institutional or value-linked fees are hypotheses; cleanup, matching and expert review can create substantial initial delivery cost.
en.traction: The site includes a Siemens procurement testimonial and customer material. Independent savings audits, renewal and complete project-cost data were unavailable.
en.moat: Item relationships, contracts and procurement history could accumulate advantages. ERP, spend analytics, consultants and internal experts compete on actual decisions.
en.funding_read: Capital supports deployment without proving that discovered value is realized. Continuing adoption and finance-confirmed net savings are useful milestones.
en.risks: Wrong equivalence can affect quality and stale contracts can misroute buying. Attribution, execution dependencies and implementation costs can overstate returns.
en.takeaway: Connect opportunity detection to execution and financial confirmation. Preserve baselines, owners and realized status rather than only a total opportunity amount.
en.watch_next: Watch realization, net savings, matching errors and implementation time, plus reuse in a second category at the same customer.
